title: McLaren Skid-Ship Multure Demo
reason: Demonstrates the operation and performance of a McLaren Skid-Ship Multure machine.

tasks.task: Depicts the operation of the McLaren Skid-Ship Multure on palm meadows.

subtasks.text: Observe the McLaren Skid-Ship Multure machine in operation.
Note the machine mulching up big pine trees.

tasks.task: Displays the resulting wood chips after the mulching process.

subtasks.text: Watch the visible wood chips left after the machine passes over.
See a single path that has been mulched by the machine.

tasks.task: Illustrates the effectiveness of the mulching process.

subtasks.text: Highlight the fine quality of the material left by the machine.
Notice the mulched trees transformed into wood chips.
